title: Islam Refutes Man-made Theories That Cover the World Today
body:
Dastoor yaa rijaalAllah. (Mawlana Shaykh stands)
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultan Allah.
Yaa Rabbana zidh Habeebika `izzan wa sharafa, nooran wa suroora, wa ridwaanan wa sultaanan. Zidnaa yaa
Rabbana bi fadlika 'l-`azheem. Grant us a good understanding and to be good servants. We are giving also
our salaat wa 's-salaam to all prophets and their deputies, `alayhim as-salaam. (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
Madad. Madad, yaa rijaalAllah. Support, O heavenly ones, we are asking for heavenly support against
Shaytan’s kingdom. And we are saluting the controller of this planet, Qutb al-Mutasarrif, Saahib az-Zamaan.
Huuu.
As-salaamu `alaykum our attenders. Don't make your Lord and Creator unhappy with you. That is a humble
association on behalf of the Seal of Prophets (s) and his kingdom.
O People! Say, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. (Mawlana
Shaykh stands) Stand up for our Lord's glorifying! (Mawlana Shaykh sits) Beware an arrow as punishment

does not to reach to you from Heavens. Allah Almighty is punishing by heavenly ones those who are not
taking care of the Kingdom of Heaven’s orders. O Mankind! Take utmost care for heavenly orders! That is our
first priority and must be well known by all Mankind. You must take the most care for heavenly commands or
a heavenly whip will come on you and you are never going to taste anything, here or Hereafter!
O Mankind! Beware from east to west, from north to south, on oceans and continents, to take care of holy
commands of Heavens. If not, a heavenly revenge will come on you. If you are running from the east,
heavenly whips will come from the east; if you are running from the west, they will come from the west; if
running from the north, they will come from the north; and if running to the south, they will come from the
south! Don't make our lives or your lives on this planet to be without meaning. Be wise ones. You are not
donkeys. You are Mankind and Mankind must munahaza, observe themselves. Don't live this life without
meaning. Shaytan is trying to teach you that this life appeared accidentally, and after a while you are going to
be dust, finishing, taken away from existence. That shaytanic mentality is covering the east and west, and all
people.
O Salafi `ulamas! Why are you not reminding Mankind? You are so proud, but pride never gives you honor
here or Hereafter. If the Lord of Heavens grants you something from real knowledge, it is your duty to
explain for unbelievers the whole system of understanding, which is going to be under their theories, not 100
percent, but 1000 percent! Now the understanding system of Mankind is that they are so proud with their
civilization, which is based on theories, and theories are Mankind's production and they have no meaning
and no taste. They don’t give tumanina, contentment and satisfaction, never. You may find the western lifesystem based on different theories, but no contentment. When they bring out a new theory, people are
running for it and leaving others, asking for contentment. But contentment can't be with theories;
contentment is in `Ilm al-Yaqeen, Knowledge of Certainty.
O Salafi `ulamas! Why are you not reminding your people not to follow western theories? Why do you insist
that western theories be taught in your universities? If you are saying, "We are jama`ah amr bi 'l-ma`roof,
“Enjoining good and forbidding evil,” then throw those theories out! I am also min ahlu ‘l-amar bi 'l-ma`roof,
and we are also making that jama`ah amr bi ‘l-ma`roof to you that you are leaving it, and taking money,
taking wisaam, taking medals from His Majesty, the King, in the most honored biqaa, area, Haramayn
Shareefayn. You are taking money! Why you are not making amr bi 'l-ma`roof, to say the truth? How many

universities are in Saudi Arabia and other Arab kingdoms? All of them are teaching nonsense theories, saying
they are the most important fruits of Mankind, and in front of you there is Holy Qur’an! Why are you not
saying everything that is not coming from Holy Qur’an is just based on WC of Shaytan? Their base is only
WC, a shaytanic base. All theories against the reality of holy books are only from shaytanic WC productions!
We do not believe in theories! Are you understanding? No one can object on what we are saying now. I am
appointed to destroy baatil, falsehood, of Shaytan and shaytanic groups who are following Shaytan step-bystep. Unbelievers and western countries may do as they like, but what about Islamic countries? Why are they
following western theories, basing their knowledge on nonsense and shaytanic theories? You are saying, “We
are Salafi `ulamas.” Which `ulamas from Salaaf as-Saalih were saying that western theories are better?
Where is the Holy Qur’an? Why did the Holy Qur’an come? Why are you not teaching that? When you are on
the minbar of Sayyidi’l-Awwaleen wa ‘l-Akhireen, Sayyidina Muhammad (s), (Mawlana Shaykh stands and
sits) why you are not ashamed to speak about theories of Christianity or Judaism, or every baatil or false way,
or thoughts and thinking? Allah will ask to you!
Islam is not based on theories, Islam is a revelation coming on Earth from Heavens! And I am sorry to say
that mulook al-Arab are not taking care for what their education system is based on. Why are they not being
responsible? Mulook must take charge and ask their education ministers, “Bring to me all books and
curricula. I must examine what you are teaching Muslim youth.”
I am sorry to say this, but I will be asked if I am not saying this thing for mulook al-Arab, mulook al-Islam
and presidents of Islamic countries. From where are they bringing their parliaments, from where they are
bringing such a jaahil, ignorant ministers that do not know what is written in their books? What is the benefit
of learning from western theories? What happened to western countries? If they are teaching their
youngsters, the new generation is never understanding anything, only running after their physical desires.
Their chairman or their most important one is Shaytan, who is ordering them, “Do this, don’t do that.”
Shaytan is saying, “Don’t believe in the Holy Qur’an, you must believe in western theories.”
Why are you not saying, VIP’s, O Salafi `ulamas, in Jumu`ah khutbah, and why are you not saying to
education ministers, “Have you ever looked at what is going to be taught to youngsters?” Bring those books
and look if their knowledge is based on Holy Qur’an or their knowledge from their books? It is not

knowledge, but we are saying knowledge from western theories. We do not believe theories. We believe in the
Holy Qur’an!
O People, Mankind, beware! I am nothing, but if heavenly batsh revenge comes to you no one can save you.
But you are running after dunya. Nothing else. Yaavil, such bad tidings for those people who are running
after western theories and asking to establish a new generation basing their lives on shaytanic theories. You
are Arabs! You know that, Asta`eedhu billah. (Mawlana Shaykh stands)
••••••• •••••••••• ••••••• ••••••••
La`alla as-sa`ata takoonu qareebaan, Perchance the Hour is now! (33:63)
(Mawlana Shaykh sits) That is ayatu 'l-kareemah. You are looking and saying, “The time of Qiyamah,
Judgment Day, is never going to happen, it is so far,” but Allah Almighty is saying, la`alla as-sa`ata takoonu
qareebaan. When His most glorified one gave heavenly knowledge to people, some of them doubted and
asked, “When will this be?” And Allah Almighty sent the ayaah, la`alla as-sa`ata takoonu qareebaan, aw
huwa aqrab min lamhu 'l-basr, it may happen so quickly! fa`alun limaa yureed, He (swt) may do anything as
He likes! Where are you? Why are you not warning people? You must make a bayyanaa wa bayynahum,
differentiation as Allah Almighty is saying,
•••••••• ••••••••• •••••••
fa-duribat baynahum bi soorin, So a wall will be put up betwixt them (57:13)
There is going to be one part on one side and one part on another side (division). Why are you not making
people know about true things? You are sleeping on baatil, false theories! Send away their cars, planes,
weapons, their nuclear bombs, and try to be heavenly ones! One heavenly being is enough to carry away all
those unbelievers’ powers they are so proud with; it is such baatil, falsehood, and no-meaning productions!
Leave those unbelievers! O mulook al-Arab, and mulook al-Islam! Leave them and be with Allah Almighty
and His most beloved one, Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen wa ’l-`Akhireen!
O People! It is a very dangerous position coming because of ghaflat an-naas, heedlessness of people who are
not looking at what is right and what is wrong, what is true and false. The whole way that the Seal of Prophets
(s) brought from Heavens is the true way. Come to declare true ways! If not, a big mass of Mankind is coming

to declare, laa ilaaha illa-Llah Muhammadun Rasoolullah. (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) You must say,
“We are followers of heavenly declarations and orders of Holy Qur'an! We do not believe in western
countries' nonsense theories and we do not fear from their nuclear bombs.”
O Mankind! The time is over. I am not asking for any payment from you; my payment from Heavens is
enough. You must try also, Salafi `ulamas, to make your payment not from mulook but from Heavens. Ask
for payment from Heavens! Where are our beliefs in Holy Qur’an? Where are our beliefs in Sayyidi 'lAwwaleen wa ’l-`Akhireen, the Seal of Prophets? People are thinking Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen wa ’l-`Akhireen,
Sayyidina Muhammad (s), (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) was sent for the tribe of Quraysh, and around
that tribe were how many tribes? Peoples’ understanding is that his prophecy and messengerhood was just
for Arabs, particularly for the Quraysh tribe. They cut their relationship with Prophet (s) and they are trying
to make another understanding system based on theories. Some claim, “We are Muslims and we are `ulamas,
but leave Muslims from the time of the Seal of Prophets (s).” They are saying, “It was like a fairytale. Now we
must establish new understanding under the light of new knowledge.” What is your new knowledge?
Theories! Their new knowledge is based on shaytanic theories. So many philosophers are saying something in
the morning and refute it at maghrib, evening; that is philosophers’ ways!
I am sorry to say the whole Islamic world is running after theories and leaving the Holy Qur’an. First, I am
sorry to say, Turks are leaving everything that belongs to the Holy Qur’an and trying to make a new religion
to make a new understanding. They are trying to leave heavenly-made things to bring Man-made, new things.
Man-made things are such a form, just shaped as a figure, but you are looking and seeing it just looks like a
man, but put another man beside it. What is the difference? One is Man-made, and one is Allah Almighty’s
khalqullah, made different. But people are drunk! Heavenly power stations shelter people who run after
heavenly-made ways for protection, while others are mostly running to be under the protection of Man-made
theories. May Allah forgive us.
O People! Beware of Shaytan, the biggest cheater, with countless tricks and traps. Yaa Allah, O our Lord! We
are running to You, asking for shelter from Heavens for believers, because others are trying to change our
beliefs to Man-made beliefs! That is balaa ul-`azham, the biggest curse! And first of all, Turkey is following
the Marxist system of Arabs, and the Islamic world is following communism or democracy, running after
Man-made baatil! Therefore, fear from heavenly revenge.

May Allah send us someone with good tidings, or the whole world is looking at bad tidings. May Allah forgive
us.
O Attenders! Take more care. You can’t hear such a thing in the east and west. I am nothing, but I am not a
Man-made one speaking to you; some heavenly ones are granting to me to speak to all nations through east
and west. Tawbah yaa Rabbee, astagfirullah.
Fatihah.
(42 minutes)
(Mawlana Shaykh prays two rakaats Salaat ash-Shukr.)
